Get Pipeline. Returns a bounded result; provider permission and resource visibility apply.

GET /api/v4/projects/{projectId}/pipelines/{id}. Read operation.

Inputs: projectId (optional), id (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, item, resource_id, web_url. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://gitlab.com), header credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: GITLAB_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: read_api for reads; api and project role permissions for deliberate writes.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). One bounded request; use the provider-specific explicit paging inputs where offered. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

Synthetic example inputs:

```json
{
  "projectId": "42",
  "id": "42"
}
```

Inputs: projectId (optional), title (optional), description (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, item, resource_id, title, web_url. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://gitlab.com), header credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: GITLAB_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: read_api for reads; api and project role permissions for deliberate writes.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). One bounded request; use the provider-specific explicit paging inputs where offered. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

Synthetic example inputs:

```json
{
  "projectId": "42",
  "title": "Synthetic task"
}
```

This example is documentation, not a run.

definitions.code:
function bounded(v){if(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(v))>1048576)throw Error('Codec value exceeds 1 MiB');return v;}

definitions.documentation: Pure reciprocal GitLab Job Nullable User codec. Exact pinned types validate all values; missing optional fields stay absent, and supported null, false, zero and empty text survive. Unknown object fields use remainder, which cannot collide with declared fields. Maximum serialized value is 1 MiB. No logging, network, secrets, filesystem or durable state. Successful execution follows Next; invalid input fails through On error. Nullable branch: isNull=true represents explicit null and omits item; isNull=false requires the exact non-null typed item. Branch on isNull before using an optional item. The discriminator is not a presence flag: a missing optional parent field is still absent.
